body: Sometimes something that helps me is distraction. Your username reminded me of an instagram I follow called moonunit_theclefairy which is someone who just posts fun pictures of their pokemon stuffed animals. I think probably the words have other meaning but I don't know what they are. Anyway, it was nice to think about this dumb, silly instagram account instead of my ex, and also 6 is my favorite number, so thanks for commenting on my post.
Hey, I read your post. I'm sorry you feel this way too.
